items.title: Drake London: Forgettable afternoon in loss
items.text:
London brought in one of six targets for eight yards in the Falcons' 16-0 loss to the Buccaneers on Sunday.

items.title: Kenny Gainwell: Career-best rushing yardage total in win
items.text:
Gainwell rushed 25 times for 140 yards in the Buccaneers' 16-0 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

items.title: George Pickens: Only two receptions in Week 8
items.text:
Pickens tallied two catches (on four targets) for 48 yards during Sunday's 33-30 overtime loss to the Cardinals.

items.title: Javonte Williams: Tops 20 carries again
items.text:
Williams churned out 56 yards on 24 carries and notched one catch (on two targets) for one yard during Sunday's 33-30 overtime defeat to the Cardinals.

items.title: Zay Flowers: Blanked with top two QBs injured
items.text:
Flowers failed to bring in any of his five targets in the Ravens' 36-10 loss to the Bills on Sunday.
